items.title: PCAR Q3 deep dive: margin gains offset supply chain and revenue challenges
items.summary: Trucking company PACCAR (NASDAQ:PCAR) fell short of the market’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, but sales rose 19% year on year to $7.94 billion. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.61 per share was 7.4% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

items.title: 5 must-read analyst questions from PACCAR’s Q3 earnings call
